correctness.rationale: For every integer d>=2 and 1<=r<=d, all real nonzero uniform hoppings and all positive shell-specific rates, contractivity identifies the exact no-loss spectral subspace. Coordinate permutations reduce the corner overlap in each Walsh eigenspace to a single invariant vector. Its value on the monitored Hamming shell is proportional to K_r(k;d), giving the exact formula with coefficients C(d,k)/2^d. The degree-two identity K_2=((d-2k)^2-d)/2 yields the if-and-only-if square law and equal-root binomial masses; Stirling gives the stated asymptotic. Independent full Fourier restriction SVD (35 cases) and full nonuniform-loss dynamics (15 cases) pass. Finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The exact infinite-family law addresses a natural monitored-network geometry: all vertices at distance r from the initial excitation have absorbing channels. At r=2 the all-or-nothing capture classification is controlled by whether the graph dimension is a square, a structural obstruction invisible to ordinary graph connectivity. The trapped mass is explicit, rate-independent under arbitrary strictly positive unequal losses, and has a sharp square-dimensional asymptotic. The calculation is not merely a tiny numerical improvement or re-labeling of a known special case, despite its use of standard tools.
